metadata.name: LightLog Phase 3 104-Class Real-World Generalization Holdout
metadata.purpose: Complex real-world blind evaluation for the frozen 104-class local recognizer after hierarchical/statistical fallback work.
blindProtocol: Keep this file outside the repository until the candidate production algorithm, model assets and thresholds are frozen.
Do not read, grep, search, parse, summarize, sample or benchmark this corpus before the production freeze.
Do not use any v7 case for training, model selection, threshold tuning, lexicon/family expansion or case-specific rules.
Run exactly once for the first blind acceptance report and preserve that report byte-for-byte.
After first execution v7 becomes regression-only data; any subsequent algorithm change requires a new unseen holdout.
notes: Retired expense.food.takeout, expense.travel.*, expense.family.*, expense.other.lost and expense.other.unexpected labels are never used.
Travel/family/beneficiary/platform contexts are deliberately present but expected labels follow actual purpose.
P2 focuses on safety-blocking behavior: failed/cancelled transactions, unlinked refunds, multiple transactions, non-transactions and missing amounts.
Receipt-like cases intentionally contain order IDs, original prices, discounts, fees or multiple numeric fields to approximate real inputs.
Content extraction is not the primary acceptance target; category/type/amount/safety/generalization are the main targets.
